items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some dates with Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: But, what I may just did in his who opened the door at Savoy Records for you?

Let’s see, I know that Ozzy Cadena was the A&R man for them. He was the owner. He didn't have anything to do with setting up the dates; he was just there. It was not Rudy Van Gelder, because he was in his home. Let's see… I did some dates with Ernie Wilkins. I don't think he was on that first one. I'm trying to think the very first date. It seems to me that Kenny Clarke, and Wendell Marshall were on that date.
I know that the first recording that Nat and Cannon did, you were on. Wendell Marshal was on those dates. I don’t know if that was the first date you did there.
